findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/story-dispatch.ts:330 supplies the unconditional promptRoleContract(agentType) when assembling the new Inventory completeness only dispatch. packages/main/src/core/prompt-role-contract-registry.ts:341 still requires topology-critic-receipt for this role, while the new role body explicitly says inventory completion does not issue topology receipts and must return after review_inventory_critic_set. Thus the actual full envelope simultaneously requires and forbids a topology receipt for the exact repaired express workflow, whose topology implementation provenance is absent. This directly contradicts the Story promise of inventory-only instructions and can stop a contract-following critic. Bind the required output contract to the selected responsibility, retaining strict topology requirements for topology dispatch, and assert the full assembled inventory envelope. This is a verified prompt-contract contradiction; no separate runtime requiredOutputIds gate or topology proof bypass is claimed.

findings.desc: handlers/review-run.ts:292 selects responsibility from live OPEN inventory but line 314 reuses prior dispatchPrompt. core/review-run.ts:640 matches that dispatch by lane/round and validates prompt/host digests without epoch/responsibility freshness. Source-traced trigger: inventory dispatch then cancel then delayed review_run_start selects topology contract with Inventory completeness only instructions; cancel/rebegin retains old epoch instructions. This reintroduces conflicting output obligations for ordinary-author work. Require matching dispatch epoch/responsibility at new run creation and redispatch on change, preserving authenticated historical run verification. Verified by precise producer/consumer source tracing, not an end-to-end mutation reproduction.

The required scoped template edit therefore aborts causal domain derivation at line 222 and prevents PRE_CERT completion (owner command reported pre_cert_causal_freshness_required). Add a bounded disjoint rule for the canonical role-template family with hash/change/deletion and unknown-sibling regressions, not a broad templates namespace admission.
